properties.title: Ukraine: single-signal dip, darknet (unsolicited traffic) down 33.0%
properties.summary: Ukraine (UA): darknet (unsolicited traffic) down 33.0% (BGP no drop, active probing no drop, darknet -33.0%) over 3 h 15 min, against the same hours of the 7 days before; the only one of IODA's signals to move. The darknet signal counts unsolicited traffic reaching the Merit Network Telescope, not traffic people send or receive. z-score -1.02 against the same 7 days. BGP held steady, so this reads as a single-source dip (BO-IND-4), not a confirmed outage. Other measurers in this country within 24 h: Cloudflare Radar 0 outages and 0 verified anomalies; NetBlocks 0 posts. Percent of normal: IODA active probing at 100% of its usual level for these hours. Exposure, an upper bound and not users affected: about 31 million people online in Ukraine (ITU 2024: 82.5% of 38 million). Access Now's STOP sheet lists 4 shutdowns here in 2025 (stated causes: conflict, other), the latest starting 2025-12-12; history only, not evidence about this outage.

properties.title: Federal Aviation Administration: 66 news headlines from 65 outlets report an outage in 6 h (usual 9.86)
properties.summary: GDELT read 66 news articles whose headlines name Federal Aviation Administration with an outage word, from 65 outlets (13wham.com, abc3340.com, abc7amarillo.com, abcnews4.com, aninews.in, austinglobe.com, bakersfieldnow.com, bignewsnetwork.com and 22 more), in the 6 hours to 10:00 UTC 26 Nov 2026, against a usual of 9.86 for that many hours over the 7 days before. The first came in GDELT's file of 04:15 UTC 26 Nov 2026. The usual rests on 611 of the 672 files of the 7 days before, the rest not yet read. Reported by the press and not confirmed by Federal Aviation Administration; Blackout links the articles and does not reproduce their headlines. Blackout does not assess its cause. A surge can also be news of an outage elsewhere that names the company, a joke, the words in another sense, or the company's own denial (BO-H-7B).
